[Benzinga news, 2026-10-29T22:02:15Z, by staff] Twilio Inc. Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
Twilio Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 financial results, exceeding analyst expectations for both revenue and adjusted earnings per share, while raising its full-year outlook.
Twilio Inc. announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting revenue of $1.56 billion and an adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of $1.65, both surpassing FactSet consensus estimates of $1.52 billion and $1.47, respectively. The company also provided its outlook for the fourth quarter, projecting revenue between $1.60 billion and $1.61 billion and adjusted EPS in the range of $1.48 to $1.53. Additionally, Twilio raised its full-year 2026 guidance for revenue growth, non-GAAP operating income, and free cash flow, citing strengthened growth and cash flow performance during the quarter.
